originalMetadata.action_plain: Turn/weight shift into single-leg balance and footstand

tentative_view.notes: Front-dominant with a turn and weight shift.

root_floor_estimate.estimation_method: tracked figure-mask bottom and foot-band median after figure isolation
root_floor_estimate.warning: Provisional corpus estimate; not canonical skeleton tracking.

source_quality.label: GOOD
source_quality.notes: Strong balance, pelvis-tilt and foot-contact evidence; clean blue background and useful view-transition material.
source_quality.caution: Ends in a different pose; the panels are not calibrated stages of one exact turn.
source_quality.assessment_basis: manual frame-by-frame review plus isolated-silhouette diagnostics

isolation.method: chroma foreground contours + left-to-right identity tracking + fixed motion envelope
isolation.ambiguous_overlap_policy: split touching foreground at tracked horizontal identity boundary
isolation.source_figure_merge_note: Raw source frames with fewer separate tall figure silhouettes than expected; these required horizontal identity partitioning.
isolation.residual_component_policy: Dominant mannequin silhouette retained; detached neighboring fragments replaced with sampled background.

calibration.method: Visually checked crown and foot-bottom guides; one constant uniform display scale
calibration.qualification: Visually checked upright source frame 0. Uniform display normalization only; no physical limb-length measurement.
